title: Microsoft 365 admin center: email notifications for organizational data processing status
summary: Hold: the controls table labels unsubscribing as user-scoped even though its scope is not documented. The page also asserts unchanged data access, connectors and roles without supporting Microsoft text. The roadmap dates, default and surrounding service's licensing requirements are supported.
